A1.justification: Both PDFs describe DeepResonance and contain complete, readable main text and Appendices A–J. Their equations, six figures, and 27 tables support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: V2 reports original DeepResonance benchmark results, zero-shot evaluations, ablations, and inference sanity checks in Section 5 and Appendices D and G–J.

after.justification: V3 retains these original empirical results, including the main benchmark comparisons and detailed appendix evaluations.

M1.justification: The dataset-construction procedure, multi-sampled ImageBind embeddings, pre-LLM fusion Transformer, alpha/beta variants, and two-stage training procedure remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Tables 1 and 5 retain the same training datasets and task coverage. Both versions evaluate the same six principal tasks and five zero-shot benchmarks, including Music4way-Any2T and both MusicInstruct variants.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within the matched experiments in Tables 2–3 and 11–21. This includes SALMONN, MU-LLaMA, OpenMU, MusiLingo, M2UGen, and the applicable NExT-GPT variants and supervised reference rows.

E3.justification: Dataset splits and sample counts, backbone configurations, metrics, and evaluation procedures are unchanged. Appendix B retains five/two training epochs, learning rate 1e-4, and batch size 16; Section 5.4 retains the same zero-shot benchmark handling.

E4.justification: Both retain the component and Transformer-depth ablations, removal of visual captions or musical features, and inference checks excluding non-text inputs. Section 5.5, Appendix D, and Appendix J contain the same analyses and evidence.

E5.justification: Appendix B in both versions states that reported results are means from three inference runs. Neither adds seed information, confidence intervals, significance tests, or other uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: All matched result-table entries and figure graphics are unchanged, including appendix results. For example, DeepResonance-beta on MusicQA remains at 35.6 BLEU-1, 41.1 ROUGE-L, and 91.6 BERTScore in Table 2.

T1.justification: Equations 1–2 and their mathematical definitions are equivalent in both versions. Differences concern spacing and typesetting; no assumptions, derivations, propositions, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The core claims about multi-way datasets, the two architectural components, and performance across six tasks and zero-shot settings remain unchanged. The abstract's resource-release update is covered under D1.

C2.justification: Both retain the same interpretations of fusion benefits and reduced flexibility on Music4way-Any2T, potential overfitting, and backbone behavior. Limitations concerning short clips, out-of-domain generalization, and generated-data biases are also unchanged.

D1.justification: V2's abstract promises a future model/dataset release; v3 states that code, models, and datasets are open-sourced and supplies a repository address. Implementation details and hyperparameters remain unchanged. The PDFs establish updated access information but cannot verify the repository contents.

R1.justification: Section 2 retains the same cited works, novelty positioning, and distinctions from earlier music and multimodal models. The bibliography contains the same works despite presentation changes.

P1.justification: V3 updates two author email addresses, adds current-affiliation footnotes, and makes limited abstract edits, including the release statement. Section ordering, terminology, and the substantive narrative remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The added front-page material and formatting changes cause text to reflow across columns and pages, including the conclusion and appendix prose. All six figures and 27 tables retain their content and organization.

improvement.justification: The repository address and explicit code/model/dataset release statement provide more useful access guidance than v2's future-release promise. This is a limited practical improvement; the scientific evidence is unchanged, the introduction still uses future release wording, and the PDFs alone do not verify the hosted materials.
